description: Phase 67 (11 October 2026), deliberate: at the user's request the Lymph nodes and Distant metastasis sections print only with a recorded input (a node examined, a metastasis recorded) or the new footer option, and pN is left out of the pTNM when no regional node was examined; only those placeholder lines and the pNX token were removed.
report:
Liver, segment 6, resection

Received in formalin is a partial hepatectomy specimen (segment 6) measuring 110 x 80 x 55 mm and weighing 210 g. There is a single tumour measuring 32 x 30 x 28 mm. The tumour is well circumscribed, tan-green and encapsulated, 8 mm from the parenchymal margin. Representative sections are taken; see block key.

(1-4) Tumour.
(5) Tumour with nearest parenchymal margin.
(6) Background liver.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Partial hepatectomy, minor (less than 3 segments)
- Tumour site: Segment 6
- Tumour focality: Solitary
- Tumour size: 3.2 cm (largest tumour, greatest dimension)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Hepatocellular carcinoma
- Histologic grade: G2: Moderately differentiated
- Tumour histology:
  The tumour is a moderately differentiated hepatocellular carcinoma. The tumour cells are hepatocyte-like, with moderate nuclear atypia, and grow in thickened trabeculae and pseudoglandular structures.
- Tumour extension: Tumour confined to liver
- Satellitosis: Not identified
- Vascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- Treatment effect: No known presurgical therapy

Margins
- Parenchymal margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 8 mm

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pT1b

Additional findings
- Cirrhosis (Ishak stage 6/6)
- Chronic hepatitis (hepatitis B)

LIVER, segment 6, resection
- Moderately differentiated HEPATOCELLULAR CARCINOMA
- Stage pT1b (pTNM, AJCC 8th edition)
- Margin clear
- CHRONIC HEPATITIS B with CIRRHOSIS (Ishak stage 6/6)
